item.title: County Shares Pilot Light Safety Tips During Cold Weather
item.description: COUNTY News: Los Alamos County shares pilot light safety to keep in mind this winter. The following tips should be taken when a pilot light goes out during cold weather: Do not try to relight it right away if you smell gas; Ventilate the area and leave the space if a gas odor is present; Follow manufacturer instructions before relighting; If unsure or the light won’t stay lit, call a qualified technician; and Use safe alternate heating sources – never use ovens or grills for heat. Read More
